feature_contract.goal: Prevent source queue sentinel replacement from relabeling a different vehicle's rank SpriteNode, while preserving frozen Calc3D2D offsets for original projected sprite, mask/animation siblings and strict ScreenHud NaviPub fallback.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: Original rank first-three sprani and fourth-plus clip wrappers, stable priority root identity and existing queue proof; no owner route, shader, source crop, FX/GOAL, SkyGlow or input changes.
trace_stages: Original car/rival Calc3D2D anchor is frozen at native RankMarker_sprani or put_clip_sprite source entry.
Native game producer can relink an old tail under a different priority root before post-call tag and fraction correction.
Per-priority root snapshot fences both fraction restoration and SpriteNode source-tag propagation; unchanged R84 R30/R33 consumes legitimate projected marker or original fallback.
subcomponents: Capture each original priority root before rank native function call and reuse for both direct sprani all-child and clipped 4th+ GPU sprite tagging.
Reject recycled or reattached old tail on a new root before any kind0/1 native subpixel mutation, but preserve still-owned sibling fractions and projected marker tags.
Extend rank fraction Release smoke negative/positive tests and require root lease in exact-original HUD semantic contract including mutation cases.

source_trace: RankMarker_sprani snapshots only old priority tails and registers all appended child nodes after original sprani_play_ae_auth_alpha returns.
RankMarker_putClipSprite snapshots only tails and RestoreAppendedRankFractions walks from current root before tagging queued sprite siblings.
FirstVerifiedAppendedNode proves old+new tail reachability but does not prove unchanged original root; a nested producer reattaching old tail to a different root may transfer rank ownership.
Stable original priority-root snapshots passed through both fraction correction and semantic registry ensure selected R84 queue owner cannot borrow foreign vehicle anchor.
diagnosis.root_cause: Two rank original producer wrappers lacked source priority-list root identity; reachable recycled tail alone is insufficient proof before applying rank displacement or projected marker tags.
alternatives_rejected: Do not rewrite R30 FVF142 projected rank path that is already implemented.
Do not globally classify all generic queue glyphs as ScreenHud or suppress native fallback/SkyGlow.
Protect matching root and still linked original child ownership; do not alter physical D3D Draw ordering.
diagnosis.fix_evidence: Original and live root equality must hold before restoring kind0/1 subpixel native geometry and registering all appended rank sprites. Tests reject foreign-root old-tail reattachment and accept same-root sibling after safe bounded proof.
